items.text: Chelili Yesu nakumishi dehi mazu ejimawa,
hakuyila atumbanji twindi nindi, Muneluki chimukuhita mafuku ayedi hipaseka, akahana Mwana kamuntu amupopeli kukulusu.
Henohu awakulumpi jawatupristu niakulumpi jawantu anapompi dehi kuchipaŋu chakapristu muneni, ijina dindi Kayafwasi.
Hiyakumusha-kamina Yesu hampùŋa, kulonda amukwati mwakudimbana, amujahi.
Hivakwila nawu, Bayi mumafuku achawija aku, antu akenza kaleta ipumba.
Chadiŋiyi Yesu muBetani, mwitala damukwambumba Shimona,
kudi yena hikukwinza mumbanda, namalasha abadika kulema wuseya muchipunda chelola dalubanji; hakuyihuŋunwina kunamutu windi, iku nashakami nakudya.
Ilaŋa tumbanji chana chimonuwu hiyakutiya kutama nankashi nawu, Nayikisaŋenidi chenichi?
Malashawa, neyi ayilandisha, adi kufwika wuseya weneni, ayinki atuzweŋi.
Yesu chanachilukiyi hakuyila nindi, Mukumu kabishiladi mumbanda? Nankoŋeli mudimu wawuwahi.
Muloŋa tuzweŋi mwekala nawu mafuku ejima, ilaŋa ami hinidi nenu mafuku ejimaku.
Muloŋa ichi chanahuŋunwiniyi malashawa hamujimba wami, nalondi kunloŋeshela kunjiika.
Nukuyileja chalala nami, mumatuŋa ejima amba kashimunawu iyi nsaŋu yayiwahi, amba katena nawa ninichichuma chaneliyi mumbandiwu, kulonda kumwanakana nachu.
Henohu wumu wahekumi nayedi, ijina dindi Yudasi Isakaroti, hakuya kudi awakulumpi jawatupristu,
nindi, Mukwiteja kunyinkadi kulonda nakamuhani kudenu? Wena hiyakumwesekela makumi asatu amali asiliva.
Kufuma henohu hakukeŋa hatela kumuhenena.
Dichi hefuku damuchimu damankendi akadi iluŋi, atumbanji hiyakwinza kudi Yesu nawu, Wunakeŋi kudiila paseka kudihi, kulonda tuloŋeshi?
Yena hakuyila nindi, Yenu muŋanda, mukuwana muntu wumu, mumwili nenu, Nkuluŋaŋa nindi, Mpinji yami yinashi ki dehi kwakwihi; nakeŋi kwinza kwitala deyi nidiiluku paseka hamu nawatumbanji twami.
Atumbanji hiyakwila mwayilejeliyi Yesu, hiyakuloŋesha paseka.
Dichi chikuneli melela hakushakama nakudya hamu nawatumbanji ikumi nayedi.
Hadiŋi nakudyawu hakwila nindi, Nukuyileja chalala nami hadi mwinenu wumu wukunfukeja.
Wena hiyakusweja kuneŋa nankashi, hiyakutachika kumwila wejima wawu nawu, Mwanta, yami tahindi?
Yena hakwakula nindi, Muntu wudi nakutanta nanami mucheŋa, diyi wukunfukeja.
Mwana kamuntu hakuya mwomwamusonekeleluwu, ilaŋa o yihuŋu yakamonayi owu muntu wukufukeja Mwana kamuntu! Owu muntu neyi havwalikiluku, mutenowu chawahili.
Yudasi, wamufukejeli, hakwakula nindi, Rabi, yami tahindi? Yena hakumwila nindi, Mwomu muwunahoshi.
Hadiŋi nakudyawu, Yesu hakunona dinkendi, hakukisula nkisu, hakudihumuna, hakuyinka atumbanji nindi, Tambulenu mudyi, weniwu diwu mujimba wami.
Hakunona lupasa, hakusakilila, hakuyinka nindi, Nwenumu wejima wenu;
muloŋa diwu mashi ami achitiyaŋenu, akupwekela antu amavulu kulonda kuyanakena nachu nyiloŋa.
Nukuyileja nami, kufuma hanu hinukunwa cheŋi yanyikabu yamuvinyuku, kuyinwa chiŋa ifuku dinakanwa nenu yayiha muwanta waTata yami.
Chanembuwu kamina, hiyakwidika, hiyakuya kumpidi yaOliveta.
Henohu Yesu hakuyileja atumbanji twindi nindi, Wufuku iwu wejima wenu mukudimboka hansaŋu yami; muloŋa anasoneki nawu, Nakatapa kabiŋa, nyikoku yeyinda akayipalaŋesha ndu-ndu.
Chinakela nasaŋuki dehi mudi afu, nakayaloŋahu dehi kuŊaliliya.
Petulu hakumwakula nindi, Neyi antu ejima akudimboka hansaŋu yeyeyi, ami kwami hinamba kadimbukaku.
Yesu hakumwila nindi, Nukukuleja chalala nami wufuku iwu, hakela ikombu kanda edi kili, eyi wakadikala kasatu neyi hinamwiluka Yesuku.
Petulu hakumwila nindi, Hela kufwa naneyi, ami hinakadikaleyuku. Niatumbanji ejima ahosheli mwomumu nawa.
Henohu Yesu hakuya chimu nawu kwatenaŋawu nawu ŋesemani; hakuyila atumbanji twindi nindi, Shalenu kunu, ami niyi nakulomba kuna.
Hakuya naPetulu nianyana kaZebedewu ayedi, hakutachika kuneŋa kwakutiya nikumuchima bwi.
Henohu hakuyila nindi, Muchima wami wunaneŋi chakubadika, neyi keŋa nifwi; shalenu kunu, mutoneni hamu nanami.
Hakuswila kumbidi chanti, hakudinata chamesu heseki, hakulomba nindi, Eyi Tata yami, neyi chinatwesheki itejaku lupasa lunu lunfumi; hela chochu, bayi chinakeŋamuku, chiŋa chiwunakeŋeyi.
Hakwinza kudi atumbanji kuyiwana adi namutulu; hakumwila Petulu nindi, Aka! kutwesha kutonena hamu nanami hela mpinji yimu nehi?
Tonenu mulombi, kulonda mubuli kwijila mukweseka; spiritu chalala yinakeŋi, ilaŋa mujimba wunazeyi.
Hakufumaku cheŋi kamuchiyedi, hakulomba nindi, Eyi Tata vami, neyi lupasilu kutwesha kunfuma nehi, chiŋa nilwinwa hohu, kumina dakwila muwunakeŋi.
Hakwinza cheŋi, kuyiwana saŋa akaminawu tulu, muloŋa mesu awu alemeni natulu.
Hakuyishiya cheŋi, hakufumaku, hakulomba kamuchisatu, hakuhosha cheŋi mazu wowamu.
Hakwinza kudi atumbanji twindi, hakuyila nindi, Kamenu tulu twenu munooki; talenu, mpinji yami yinashi ki dehi kwakwihi, Mwana kamuntu hiyakumuhana kumakasa awakwanshidi.
Nyamokenu tuyenu; talenu, wukunfukeja hadi kwakwihi.
Iku wuchidi kuhosha, kukasumuka Yudasi wahekumi nayedi nenzi dehi, nezaza dawantu dadeni, anasendi nimpoku jatubali ninyitondu, anafumi kudi awakulumpi jawatupristu nikudi awakulumpi jawantu.
Yena wamufukejeli wayileja dehi chinjikijilu nindi, Yowu nakapwepula, diyi mwakakwata.
Hohenohu hakwinza kudi Yesu, hakumwila nindi, Kolenu Rabi. Hakumupwepujola.
Yesu hakumwila nindi, Eyi mukwetu, ilaku chiwunenjili. Dichi enza nikwinza, amukwata nikumukwata, hiyakumutwala.
Kutala mwinawu wumu wadiŋi naYesu, hakwolola chikasa chindi, hakuhola mpoku yindi yakabali, hakutapa nduŋu yakapristu muneni kutapa kwakumuketula itu dindi.
Yesu hakumwila henohu nindi, Somekaku cheŋi mpoku yeyi yakabali muchindalu chayu; muloŋa antu ejima akukwata kumpoku yakabali akafwa kumpoku yakabali.
Eyi wunatoŋojoki neyi ami nikaŋanyi kumulembelela Tata yami, antemesheli katatakichi aŋelu akubadika nyikanka ikumi nayiyedi?
Indi nyikanda yajila yelawu nawu dichi chakelawu, yakalumbulukila hadihi?
Yena mpinji oyu Yesu hakuyila mazaza awantu nindi, Munenzi nakunkwata nampoku jatubali ninyitondu! Ami niikombi? Nashakamini mutembeli hefuku hefuku nakuleja antu, enu kunkwata nehi.
Ilaŋa yuma yejimiyi yinalondi nyikanda yawatuprofwetu yajila yakalumbuluki. Hohenohu atumbanji ejima amushiya nikumushiya, atemoka nikutemoka.
Awa akwatili Yesu amutweli kwitala dakapristu muneni Kayafwasi, kwadipompela dehi ansoneki nawawakulumpi.
Ilaŋa Petulu wamulondeleli munyima kwakulehi, lwe nikuchipaŋu chakapristu muneni, hakushakama nawatupita, kulonda atali muchakakumina.
Dichi awakulumpi jawatupristu, niakwachota ejima, hiyakukeŋakeŋa nsaŋu yakumutwambila Yesu, kulonda amujahi nachu;
hiyayimwenuku, hela kwenjili ayinsahu akutwamba amavulu. Nkumininaku hikukwinza ayedi,
elili nawu, Iwu iyala welaŋa nindi, Ami nukutwesha kusanda tembeli yaNzambi, hinukuyituŋa cheŋi mumafuku asatu.
Kapristu muneni hakwimana, hakumwila nindi, Eyi niizu diwukwakula nehi? Iyi yuma yidi nakukushimunawu hiyumanyi?
Yesu saŋa amwenenayi zo. Kapristu muneni hakumwila nindi, Nakusanyikishi Nzambi wamumi, tuleji neyi yeyi Kristu, Mwana kaNzambi.
Yesu hakumwila nindi, Mwomwenomu muwunahoshi; nukuyileja nami, mwamba kamona Mwana kamuntu nashakami kuchikasa chachidiilu chaŋovu, hakwinza hamavu amwiwulu.
Kapristu muneni hakutabola mahinindi nindi, Nahoshi mazu akutuka Nzambi, tukukeŋeladi nawa ayinsahu amakwawu? Enu aweni munatiyi chanatukaniyi.
Munatoŋojoki ŋahi? Wena hiyakwakula nawu, Nateli kufwa.
Hohenohu hiyakumufwŋila mazeŋi kumesu indi, hiyakumweta makonyi, amakwawu hiyakumweta makahi,
nawu, Eyi Kristu, tuprofweteli, nakweti hinyi?
Henohu Petulu nashakami muchipaŋu hanzi; kudi yena hikukwinza chaŋadima wumu, hakumwila nindi, Eyi nawa wadiŋi naniwu kaŊaliliya Yesu.
Yena hakudikala kumesu awu wejima wawu nindi, Ichi chiwunahoshi ami kwami kuchiluka nehi.
Chanedikiyi mwikeki, mukwawu nawa hakumumona, hakuyila owu adiŋuku nindi, Iwu muntu niyena wadiŋi nakaNazareta Yesu.
Hakudikala cheŋi nikusanyika chikupu nindi, Yeniwu muntu ami kwami hinamwilukaku.
Chihanahiti kapinji kantesha antu emenuku hiyakwinza, hiyakumwila Petulu nawu, Chalala yeyi mwinawu; muloŋa idimi deyi dinakushimuni.
Hohenohu atachika nikudishiŋola nikusanyika chikupu nindi, Yeniwu muntu ami kwami hinamwilukaku. Hohenohu ikombu edikila nikwidikila.
Petulu hakwanuka izu damwililiyi Yesu nindi, Eyi wakadikala kasatu hakela ikombu kanda edi kili. Hakwidika nakudila nankashi.
